headline: Trump threatens to strike Iran's infrastructure if Strait of Hormuz isn't reopened
summary: US President Donald Trump stepped up on Sunday his threat to hit Iran's critical infrastructure hard if Tehran does not reopen the Strait of Hormuz.
why: The Strait of Hormuz is a key oil transit chokepoint, so disruptions there can quickly affect global crude supply and prices.
why_moved: The threat targets Iran's infrastructure over the closure of the Strait of Hormuz, a route that carries a large share of seaborne oil, raising supply-risk concerns.
